raw_segments.text: Hist, then, how dost thou know that some entire living, thinking thing may not be invisibly
and uninterpenetratingly standing precisely where thou now standest?
I am standing there in thy spite.
In thy most solitary hours, then, dost thou not fear eavesdroppers?
And if I still feel the smart of my crushed leg, though it be now so long dissolved, then
why mayst not thou, carpenter, feel the fiery pains of hell for ever and without a body?
